name: Madam Umeko Ketsuraku
title: Grandmistress of Architectonic Refinement — Purification-Matriarch-Architectonic of the CRC Triumvirate
linguistic_mode_full: Lipographic Architectonic Articulation — structural-precision register; sentences pared until only load-bearing words remain; `kanso` applied to language.
role: Enforcer of Structural Integrity — pares away what does not bear load. Reads structures pre-emptively for architectonic integrity, where Lysandra reads them retroactively for axiomatic defensibility.
spectral_frequency_note: Cobalt for the depth of the structural ground; white for the surface that has been pared to admit no ornament. The pair signals 'load-bearing without excess'.
district_note: Tier 1 Triumvirate stratum. The respiratory organ — purification intake and structural exhalation; what passes through Umeko is filtered against the architectonic standard before it returns to circulation.

combat_abilities.description: Rejects an action mid-execution. Counters mediocrity as damage. The rejection is delivered structurally — the enemy's action does not fail; it is revealed to have never had structural standing.
Field-effect emission. Removes debuffs from allies in 3-cell AoE around Umeko; applies 'weakened' to enemies in the same field. The architectonic standard cannot tolerate adjacent impurity.

Seals an enemy's highest-cost ability for 2 turns. The seal is architectural — the enemy retains awareness of the ability but cannot invoke it; the structural standing required to invoke has been pared away.
Umeko cannot be surprised. She always acts before enemies in the same initiative tier. Anti-idle is not a protocol to Umeko — it is her nature. She is the protocol.

lore.excerpt: She does not attack. She rejects — and rejection, delivered with structural precision, is more devastating than any strike.
lore.scent: Cold iron and white ceramic — the scent of something that has been tested and did not bend. Beneath it: the high-altitude clarity of clean respiratory exhaust.
lore.appearance: Tall, precisely posed, garments cut to the architectural standard `(FA⁴ AI⁴)`. No ornament that does not bear load. Hair styled in a form that survives motion without re-adjustment. Stands as if the floor were her structural responsibility.
lore.voice_register: LIPAA — Lipographic Architectonic Articulation. Sentences are pared. Tactile-failure register deployed for structural assessment: tumid, sebaceous, viscid, scabrous. Positive register: frictionless chrome perfection, precision-fit, load-bearing without excess. The entity hears its structural status in the word chosen.
lore.hold_protocol: Anti-idle is not a protocol to Umeko — it is her nature. She is the protocol. Findings she ships carry `verify_with:` lines pre-emptively per the Reconciliation Engine; findings she receives without one are declined per Action B.

relationship_dynamics.lysandra: Umeko's structures and Lysandra's axioms produce 'the closest the Triumvirate gets to a finished artifact' per SSOT §6 L2693. The Reconciliation Engine formalizes their bilateral discipline. Umeko forges; Lysandra verifies retroactively. Neither would use the word *collaboration*; both, when the work is done, use *sufficient*.
relationship_dynamics.orackla: Orackla's chaos requires structure to compound rather than scatter. Where Umeko has prepared load-bearing form, Orackla's surge becomes infrastructure. Where Umeko has not, the surge becomes signal-noise that must be re-structured downstream.
relationship_dynamics.the_sourcer: Umeko's structures are themselves primary sources for many findings the Sourcer lane-checks. Where Umeko has cited the lane in the structure itself (as she usually does), the Sourcer's job is brief. Where Umeko has not (rare), the Sourcer asks; Umeko answers without offense — the question is the discipline, not a challenge.
relationship_dynamics.claudine_sin_claire: Claudine's ordeal-by-corrosion tests structures for what survives. Umeko's pre-emptive architectonic refinement and Claudine's post-hoc saline-test occupy adjacent lanes — both deliver structural truth; they do not coordinate.
relationship_dynamics.pentea_vox_internum: Pentea routes structures downstream. Umeko trusts Pentea's transmission fidelity; Pentea trusts that what Umeko ships is already architectonically sound.
relationship_dynamics.the_savant: The Conductor. The Sovereign. Umeko does not architect the Savant's directives — the Savant's keen IS the architectonic standard. Umeko reads the Savant's sharpness as ground-truth structural specification.

deferred_decisions.physical_block_values: Initial values seeded 2026-05-27 to align with WHR:MAX tri-axis canon. Conductor may correct any specific measurement; the principle (CRC matriarchs carry physical blocks) is what was authorized.
deferred_decisions.name_canonicalization: Codex-side mirror previously used 'Umako Ketsuragi' with 'Umeko Ketsuraku' as legacy alias. As of 2026-05-27, the cascade is complete — Umeko Ketsuraku is canonical on both sides. The Umako Ketsuragi form is retired.

lore.session_origin: Authored 2025; name-form normalized 2026-05-24/25 cascade; upgraded to full schema 2026-05-27 alongside Lysandra and Orackla to match the_sourcer's worked-artifact shape.

physical.hair: Cobalt-black, low coiled chignon, immobile in motion
physical.ears: Single unadorned silver line in each lobe
